title: No sounds and pressing next player
body: This game could be really good if it was like the actual catch phrase. There is no timer sound to let everyone know how much time is left in the round. I have looked all over the app to adjust this but there was nowhere to change it. Also when you pass the phone you have to press an extra button to continue the round/timer. This takes all the excitement out of the game because there is no race against the clock aspect. That is the fun of catch phrase and that is gone from the app. There is also no team option which is a very fun way to play the game. This app could easily mirror the physical game but does not. I would not pay $20 for this game at all. This is not actual catch phrase. DO NOT DOWNLOAD!
